test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which organisation released the 'Global Risks Report, 2025', outlining geopolitical, environmental and technological threats?

options.text: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

solution:
The correct answer is __**World Economic Forum (WEF)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Economic Forum (WEF)** published the **20th edition** of the **Global Risks Report 2025** in **January 2025**.
 
• This annual report is released just before the **WEF Annual Meeting** held in **Davos, Switzerland**, providing a foundation for discussions among global leaders.
 
• The **2025 report** identifies **Misinformation and Disinformation** as the most severe global risk anticipated over the next **two years**, fueled by advancements in **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**.
 
• It outlines a range of threats categorized into **Geopolitical**, **Environmental**, **Technological**, **Societal**, and **Economic** domains.
 
• The report warns of a "**Global Fragmentation**" where the world is moving toward a **multipolar** order, making international cooperation on critical issues like **Climate Change** and **Cybersecurity** more difficult.
 
• According to the findings, **Extreme weather events** and **Critical change to Earth systems** are ranked as the top long-term risks over a **10-year** period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Economic Forum (WEF):**
 
 
• It is an international non-governmental and lobbying organization founded on **24 January 1971** by German engineer and economist **Klaus Schwab**.
 
• The headquarters are located in **Cologny, Switzerland**.
 
• Other major reports published by the **WEF** include the **Global Gender Gap Report**, **Energy Transition Index**, **Global Competitiveness Report**, and **Travel and Tourism Development Index**.
 
 
 
• **International Monetary Fund (IMF):**
 
 
• Established in **1944** at the **Bretton Woods Conference**, it is headquartered in **Washington, D.C., USA**.
 
• It primarily releases the **World Economic Outlook** and the **Global Financial Stability Report**.
 
 
 
• **Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD):**
 
 
• An intergovernmental organization with **38 member countries**, founded in **1961** and based in **Paris, France**.
 
• It is well-known for the **PISA (Programme for International Student Assessment)** and various economic and environmental surveys.
 
 
 
• **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP):**
 
 
• The **UNDP** is the **United Nations'** global development network, established in **1965**.
 
• It is most famous for publishing the **Human Development Report (HDR)**, which includes the **Human Development Index (HDI)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Methodology:** The **Global Risks Report** is based on the **Global Risks Perception Survey (GRPS)**, which captures the views of nearly **1,500 experts** from academia, business, government, and the international community.
 
• **Short-term vs. Long-term:** The report distinguishes between immediate crises (**0-2 years**) and structural transformations (**10 years**). While **technological** and **societal** issues dominate the short term, **environmental** risks are the primary concern for the next decade.
 
• **Geopolitical Shifts:** The **2025** report emphasizes the risk of **Armed Conflict** and **Geoeconomic Confrontation**, noting that the breakdown of global norms is leading to a more volatile and insecure world.
 
• **AI and Society:** The report highlights how **synthetic content** (deepfakes) and **AI-generated misinformation** can manipulate public opinion and threaten the legitimacy of **elections** globally.
</ul
